owner: Owner decision 4 of 29.10.2026 (V13b): pre-2010 delistings; prioritise real additional price and terminal-value evidence from SEC originals; no invented terminal values, no blanket admission.
registeredBefore: Committed before any merger/tender document was retrieved or read for this register. Seen so far: scope counts from the public V12 SPXPOP population-1.1.1 (502 bounded SPY exit rows with t0 <= 2009-09-30, 325 with CIK; fate counts) and the structure (not the content) of the private V12 detail/snapshot files.

inputs.detail: private V12 SPXPOP detail-1.1.1.json (per row: holdings name, key, weight, p0 = value/shares from the SEC fund report at t0); row order = population cols order (checked: keyHash16 = sha256(key)[:16] must equal the population chain key for every row, else abort)
inputs.submissions: issuer submissions JSON (data.sec.gov), cache of V12 INDEXPOP fates.py reused, new requests only when not cached

scope: SPY periods of V12 SPXPOP 1.1.1 with t0 <= 2009-09-30 (15 periods, t1 up to 2010-03-31); rows with status BOUNDED_EXIT or BOUNDED_EXIT_SERIES_DELISTED. Unit = row (fund period x holding).

steps.S1_candidates: Rows with CIK and V12 fate in {ACQUIRED_OR_MERGED, ACQUIRED_OR_MERGED_NO_25_15, DELISTED_OTHER, NO_SEC_EVIDENCE, NOT_FATED} are acquisition candidates. Fates STILL_REPORTING_INDEX_EXIT, TEMPORARY_ABSENCE, DELISTED_BANKRUPTCY, BANKRUPTCY_NO_25_15, IDENTITY_BREAK, CIK_NAME_MISMATCH and rows without CIK stay BOUNDED with that reason (no terminal value is derived for them).
steps.S2_documents: From the issuer's filing list: consideration documents = forms DEFM14A, DEFM14C, DEFS14A, DEFR14A, DEFA14A, PREM14A, SC TO-T, SC TO-T/A, SC 14D1, SC 14D1/A, SC 14D9, SC 14D9/A, SC 13E3, SC 13E3/A, 425, 8-K, 8-K/A filed in (t0 - 540d, t1 + 30d]; deregistration = Form 15-12B, 15-12G, 15-15D, 25, 25-NSE filed in (t0, t1 + 120d]. Retrieval order: newest first; at most 6 consideration documents per row (first 2,000,000 bytes of the complete submission text each).
steps.S3_extraction: Deterministic patterns on tag-stripped, whitespace-normalised text. CASH: '(converted into|exchanged for|cancel(l)ed ... in exchange for|right to receive|offer to purchase all ... (shares|common stock) ... at (a price of)?) ... $X (net to the seller in cash|in cash|per share in cash|per share, (net )?in cash)'. STOCK: 'right to receive ... R (shares|of a share) of <name> common stock' or 'exchange ratio of R'. Election/proration/collar/CVR/'value of'/'average (closing )?price' within the same sentence mark the sentence ELECTION_OR_FLOATING. An increased offer ('increase(d)? the offer price to $X', 'amended ... to increase ... to $X') overrides earlier tender prices.
steps.S4_decision: Use the newest document (by filing date, ties by accession) that contains a consideration sentence. TERMINAL_CASH: all consideration sentences of that document give one distinct cash amount C and no STOCK or ELECTION_OR_FLOATING sentence; TERMINAL_STOCK: one distinct ratio R, no cash, no ELECTION_OR_FLOATING; TERMINAL_MIXED: exactly one cash amount C and one ratio R in the same sentence, no ELECTION_OR_FLOATING. Otherwise BOUNDED_AMBIGUOUS_CONSIDERATION (no document) or BOUNDED_NO_CONSIDERATION_DOCUMENT (none found).
steps.S5_completion: Completion evidence required: a deregistration form filed in (t0, t1 + 10d] after the consideration document, or a document filed in (t0, t1 + 10d] stating that the merger/offer was completed/consummated/became effective. Deregistration only after t1 + 10d -> BOUNDED_COMPLETION_AFTER_T1 (the member left the index before the deal closed; its price at t1 is unknown). None -> BOUNDED_NO_COMPLETION_EVIDENCE.
steps.S6_acquirer_price: STOCK/MIXED only: acquirer CIK = 'FILED BY' CIK of a 425 or SC TO-T in the issuer's window, or the single other filer CIK in the header of the consideration document; must be unique. Acquirer price P_acq(t1) = value/shares of the SPY holding with that CIK at t1 (V12 detail row of the period starting at t1). The acquirer must be held in SPY at t1 and, in every SPY period overlapping [document date, t1], have split class NONE or SHARE_CHANGE (not SPLIT, not AMBIGUOUS_CA). Else BOUNDED_NO_ACQUIRER_PRICE or BOUNDED_ACQUIRER_CA.
steps.S7_return: Period price return (same convention as SPXPOP: price only, no dividends; cash received at completion earns 0 until t1; acquirer shares held until t1): R = (C + R_ratio * P_acq(t1)) / p0 - 1 with C = 0 or R_ratio = 0 as applicable; p0 from the SEC fund report at t0.
steps.S8_plausibility: Fail-closed guard against unrecorded target splits between t0 and completion: let v = (C + R_ratio * P_acq(t1)) / p0. If v is outside [1/3, 3] or within 3 % of 2, 3, 4, 5, 10 or their inverses -> BOUNDED_CA_SUSPECT (value reported privately, not used).
steps.S9_status: Accepted rows get status TERMINAL_CASH / TERMINAL_STOCK / TERMINAL_MIXED with point return R (no band); all other rows keep the V12 bound (point 0 %, lower -100 %, no upper) with a reason code.

outputs.register: docs/quant-recovery/v13b/hist/spx-terminal-register-1.0.0.json: one row per scoped row (period, keyHash16, CIK, holdings name, V12 fate, status, reason, C, ratio, acquirer CIK, R, evidence accession/URL/SHA-256/quote <= 300 chars, deregistration accession/date).
outputs.coverage: docs/quant-recovery/v13b/hist/spx-terminal-coverage-1.0.0.json: per SPY period bounded weight and bounded count before/after, and as a DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (never used to choose or tune anything) the SPXPOP consistency error (sum w0*R vs SPY price return) before/after; per-year gap table SEC delisting events vs price/terminal evidence 1995-2009; Tiingo supported-ticker coverage of the scoped exits; count of sparse price observations of exited members in other cached fund reports.
outputs.unobservable: Explicit list of what remains bounded and why.

independentCheck: python3 -I stdlib re-implementation from cached raw SEC bytes (own HTML stripping, own patterns written independently, own completion and acquirer logic, own p0 from the raw fund reports via the V12 snapshot file), comparing every accepted row and every reason code; differences are reported, not hidden.
